decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting is a specialized maritime project with substantial certification and engineering investment and visible commitment to naval customers, so management persists despite its distance from the core offer, with long naval procurement cycles giving a ready temporary explanation for slow results.
Explosion-proof industrial luminaires build on the core offer, carry heavy certification investment and were actively extended with an LED replacement kit, showing ongoing commitment.
The designer task light was publicly relaunched as a popular product and presented on its own page, so dropping it would expose the relaunch decision as a mistake.

The pendant office luminaire sits close to the core LED office lighting business, where tooling is already invested, and any weak sales can be attributed to the pandemic slowdown in office construction.

The premium pendant luminaire fits the announced direction toward innovative, energy-efficient LED solutions and was showcased on its own page, so management keeps it and treats weak results as temporary.
